title: there was/were there has/have been
summary: **There was / There were** — «был(о/и)» в прошлом, **There has/have been** — «был(о/и)» с результатом сейчас, **There will be** — «будет».
ru:
## There is → there was
Чтобы сказать, что что-то было в прошлом, меняем **is/are** на **was/were**.
> There is a good film on TV tonight. — Сегодня по телевизору хороший фильм.
> There **was** a good film on TV last night. — Вчера вечером по телевизору был хороший фильм.
> There **were** 250 rooms in the hotel. — В гостинице было 250 номеров.

- **there was** — один предмет или неисчисляемое
- **there were** — несколько предметов

## Отрицание и вопросы
> There wasn't a bank in the village. — В деревне не было банка.
> There weren't any chairs. — Стульев не было.
> Was there a party last Friday? — Была вечеринка в прошлую пятницу? — Yes, there was. / No, there wasn't.
> Were there any letters for me? — Были письма для меня? — Yes, there were. / No, there weren't.

## there has been / there have been
Когда у прошлого события есть результат **сейчас** или время не названо, говорим **there has been / there have been**.
> Look! There's been an accident. — Смотри! Произошла авария. (there's been = there has been)
> There have been many accidents on this road. — На этой дороге было много аварий.
Но если есть точное время в прошлом (yesterday, last night), нужно **there was**:
> There was an accident last night. — Вчера вечером была авария.
> ~~There has been an accident last night.~~

## there will be
Для будущего: **there will be** («будет, будут») — одна форма для всех.
> There will be a lot of people at the party. — На вечеринке будет много людей.
> I think there will be snow tomorrow. — Думаю, завтра будет снег.
> There won't be any problems. — Проблем не будет.
> Will there be a test tomorrow? — Завтра будет контрольная?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~There was two cars.~~ → There **were** two cars.
- ~~Was there any students?~~ → **Were** there any students?
- ~~There has been an accident yesterday.~~ → There **was** an accident yesterday.
- ~~There will be a lot of people tomorrow?~~ → **Will there be** a lot of people tomorrow?
en:
## There is → there was
To talk about the past, we change **is/are** to **was/were**.
> There is a good film on TV tonight.
> There **was** a good film on TV last night.
> There **were** 250 rooms in the hotel.

- **there was** — one thing or an uncountable noun
- **there were** — more than one thing

## Negative and questions
> There wasn't a bank in the village.
> There weren't any chairs.
> Was there a party last Friday? — Yes, there was. / No, there wasn't.
> Were there any letters for me? — Yes, there were. / No, there weren't.

## there has been / there have been
We use **there has been / there have been** when the past event has a result now, or the time is not given.
> Look! There's been an accident.
> There have been many accidents on this road.
With a finished time (yesterday, last night) we use **there was**:
> There was an accident last night.
> ~~There has been an accident last night.~~

## there will be
For the future: **there will be**.
> There will be a lot of people at the party.
> I think there will be snow tomorrow.
> There won't be any problems.
> Will there be a test tomorrow?

## Common mistakes
- ~~There was two cars.~~ → There **were** two cars.
- ~~Was there any students?~~ → **Were** there any students?
- ~~There has been an accident yesterday.~~ → There **was** an accident yesterday.
structure:
## Времена
| Время | Единственное | Множественное |
|---|---|---|
| Настоящее | there is | there are |
| Прошедшее | there was | there were |
| Present perfect | there has been | there have been |
| Будущее | there will be | there will be |

## Отрицание
| Время | Форма |
|---|---|
| Прошедшее | there wasn't / there weren't |
| Present perfect | there hasn't been / there haven't been |
| Будущее | there won't be |

## Вопросы и краткие ответы
| Вопрос | Краткие ответы |
|---|---|
| Was there a test? | Yes, there was. / No, there wasn't. |
| Were there any problems? | Yes, there were. / No, there weren't. |
| Will there be a party? | Yes, there will. / No, there won't. |

## Формула
> **There was / were** + предмет + (время в прошлом)
> **There has / have been** + предмет (без точного времени)
> **There will be** + предмет

## Запомните
- с yesterday / last week / in 2020 — только **there was / were**;
- **there's been** = there has been.

items.text: There {{was}} a big storm last night.
There {{were}} a lot of people at the concert.
There {{was}} no milk in the fridge yesterday.
{{Were}} there any problems with the trip?
{{Was}} there a bank in your old town?
There {{wasn't|was not}} a car near the house, but there were two bikes.

exercises.title: Какая форма
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **there was / there were / there has been / there have been / there will be**.

items.text: I think {{there will be|there'll be}} a lot of snow tomorrow.
Be careful! {{There's been|There has been}} an accident on this road.
{{There were}} two cats in the garden yesterday.
Look at the river! {{There has been|There's been}} a lot of rain.
{{There was}} a party at my house last Saturday.
There are no tickets now, but {{there will be|there'll be}} some tomorrow.

items.q: When we arrived, ___ no taxis at the station.
___ a lot of people at the party last Sunday?
items.why: Прошлое + a lot of people (множ.) → **Were there**.

items.q: There ___ a test tomorrow. Don't worry.
Look! There ___ a mistake in the text.
items.why: Результат сейчас, не названо время → **there's been**.

items.q: Как сказать «Вчера в парке было много людей»?
options: There was a lot of people in the park yesterday.
There were a lot of people in the park yesterday.
There have been a lot of people in the park yesterday.
Has there been a test yesterday?

items.q: Как сказать «Здесь было много аварий» (сейчас, без точного времени)?
options: There have been many accidents here.
There has been many accidents here.

items.prompt: (there / a good film / on TV / last night)
answers: There was a good film on TV last night.
Last night there was a good film on TV.
There weren't any tickets yesterday.
There were not any tickets yesterday.
Yesterday there weren't any tickets.
Yesterday there were not any tickets.
There have been many accidents on this road.
There've been many accidents on this road.

items.prompt: (there / a lot of people / at the party / tomorrow)
answers: There will be a lot of people at the party tomorrow.
Tomorrow there will be a lot of people at the party.
There'll be a lot of people at the party tomorrow.
Tomorrow there'll be a lot of people at the party.

items.prompt: (there / a bank / in the village / ? / last year)
answers: Was there a bank in the village last year?
Was there a bank in the village?

exercises.title: Переведите на английский
exercises.instruction: Переведите. Используйте **there was / were / has been / have been / will be**.

items.prompt: Вчера в классе было двадцать студентов.
answers: There were twenty students in the class yesterday.
Yesterday there were twenty students in the class.
There were twenty students in the classroom yesterday.
Yesterday there were twenty students in the classroom.
There were 20 students in the class yesterday.
Yesterday there were 20 students in the class.
There will be a party tomorrow.
Tomorrow there will be a party.
There'll be a party tomorrow.
Tomorrow there'll be a party.
There wasn't any food in the fridge.
There was no food in the fridge.
There wasn't food in the fridge.
Look! There's been an accident.
Look! There has been an accident.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: How many people were there at your last birthday?

What will there be in your city in 20 years?
